description.p: A native music client for OpenSubsonic and compatible Subsonic servers, forked from Spotifast and written in Rust without a browser engine.

Browse your music, search songs and server playlists, rate and heart songs, manage the queue and download originals for local-first playback. Includes an equalizer, visualizers and a classic Winamp-style mini-player.
A cleaner icon-based audio output picker and Cast receiver verification with remembered certificate fingerprints.
Snapcast audio sending, a built-in synchronized PCM/FLAC receiver, Docker interoperability tests and an isolated smoke environment.
Saved server connections, credential-preserving disconnect, per-server queues and a Sync now library refresh control.
OpenSubsonic server playback, playlists, song feedback, lyrics, scrobbling and original downloads.
